title: Product Launch Videos: Concepts, Scripts, and Plan
summary: Plan product launch videos as a coordinated package: hero story, product demo, social ads, founder message, landing-page video, and cutdowns.
body_markdown:
## Create the asset matrix


List audience, angle, format, duration, ratio, channel, CTA, source assets, owner, approval status, and launch date. Design vertical, horizontal, and feed versions for their placements rather than cropping after completion.


## Production timeline


1. Approve positioning, facts, claims, and source assets.
2. Approve launch idea and angle map.
3. Produce hero and demonstration sources.
4. Create channel variants and cutdowns.
5. Complete brand, product, legal, caption, and spec review.
6. Test destinations, tracking, scheduling, and fallback assets.
7. Record post-launch learnings and refresh plan.


## Measure the launch


Track reach and video behavior, qualified site engagement, demo or trial starts, activation, pipeline or revenue, and the contribution of each angle. Label product-entry clicks separately from verified signups.
